نتكورن (form IIq)
# نَتَكَوْرَنُ (natakawranu) /na.ta.kaw.ra.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَوْرَنَ (takawrana)
# نَتَكَوْرَنَ (natakawrana) /na.ta.kaw.ra.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَوْرَنَ (takawrana)
# نَتَكَوْرَنْ (natakawran) /na.ta.kaw.ran/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَوْرَنَ (takawrana)
